about: BOSS SIGNATURE MECHANICS (Dom 2026-10-28: each boss has its own fighting identity). A map: mechanic id -> its row. A ring boss names its id in data/rings.json bosses[].mechanic (null = none). Each row's `type` picks the code in src/fight/mechanics/ (one registry line each in src/fight/mechanics/index.ts) and its `boss` is the data/profiles.json id it belongs to; every number below is read by that code, never written in it (src/sim/validate.js validateMechanics checks the values). Rules for every row: damage comes from the boss's own move rows, a blow is never lethal unless the row says so, nothing runs while the boss is down or the hero is dead.

gourd.about: LORD GOURD, PUMPKIN BOMBS: he stomps, then lobs gourds that land on the hero's spot as glowing ground rings and burst after a fuse (area hit, small shove). Step or roll out of a ring before it bursts. The aim is taken when the gourd leaves his hand, so a hero who keeps moving is missed; one who stands is hit. `count`/`countLow`: gourds per cast, more once he is under `lowShare` of his health. `damageMove` x `damageShare`: the blow is the boss's own move row (damage on a hit, scaled by his sheet's attack dial and the hero's armour). `guardShare`: the share that gets through a raised guard. A roll inside its safe frames takes none.

king-aura.about: The King (big-vegas): a pulsing stage spotlight around him. Inside it the hero's stamina regrows at regenFactor and a small tick of his max health is lost every tickEveryTicks. Every period the ring flares (the tell, pulseTellTicks), then a wave runs out from the King over pulseWaveTicks and hurts whoever it passes who is not mid-roll. The ring shrinks with the King's health (radiusMetres at full, minRadiusMetres at none); below frenzyBelowFraction of his health the period is frenzyPeriodTicks. Ticks and the wave never kill (the hero keeps at least 1 health). Ends the tick the King falls. Ticks are the sim's 60 Hz. The tick damage and the wave ride the King's damage multiplier (ring, star, Daily Pit), like his blows.
